第45章 又多了一笔奖金-《系统送编，从外卖员成007探员》

顾承安下楼去了趟超市，扛着大包小包回来，塞满冰箱，他看了眼时间，上午十一点。

打开灶台，炒了个番茄炒蛋，煮了碗紫菜蛋花汤，一菜一汤，标准的单身汉配置。

吃饭的时候他掏出手机刷了刷新闻，魔都那边的案子新闻上一个字没提，这才正常，国安的案子上了新闻，那才叫出大事。

饭后他把锅碗瓢盆洗干净。

换了身干净的衣服，看了看时间还早。

坐在沙发上休息一会。

下午一点多。

顾承安觉得差不多了，拿上钥匙出门。

楼下车棚里，他那辆电驴身上同样蒙了一层灰。

顾承安从扶手箱里翻出条毛巾，三下五除二把车擦干净。拧钥匙，仪表盘亮起，电量显示还有百分之七十三。

“还挺争气。”

他跨上车，拧油门。

鹏城的午后，太阳毒得能把鸡蛋煎熟。骑在路上，热浪从柏油路面蒸腾上来，还好他现在比较扛煎。

到市局门口，顾承安掏出手机看了眼——一点四十七。

岗亭登记过安检，他轻车熟路地上楼，拐了两个弯，找到苏楠的办公室。

门开着，里面坐着三个人，都在对着电脑忙活，没有看到苏楠的身影。

顾承安退出来，掏出手机在微讯上给苏楠发了条消息：

【我到了，没看到你！】

过了一会，对方才回复了：

“在外面出任务，你等我一会儿，坐办公室里吹吹空调。”

顾承安重新走进去，靠门最近的一个年轻便衣警察抬起头，上下打量了他一眼：“找谁？”

“找苏队，她让我在这等会儿。”

那便衣一听是苏队认识的人，态度立马热情了两分，起身从墙角拖了把椅子过来：“坐，喝水自己倒啊，饮水机在那边。”

顾承安道了声谢，坐下来百无聊赖地刷手机。

系统还在升级中，进度条走了大概三分之一，剩余时间十五个小时左右。

Gu Chengan went downstairs to the supermarket and came back with large and small bags, stuffed in the refrigerator. He looked at the time, eleven o'clock in the morning.

I turned on the stove, fried a tomato scrambled egg, and cooked a bowl of seaweed and egg drop soup, one vegetable and one soup, a standard configuration for a bachelor.

While eating, he took out his mobile phone and scrolled through the news. The case in Shanghai was not mentioned at all, which is normal. Only when the case of the National Security Bureau was in the news, it became a big deal.

After the meal he washed the pots and pans.

I changed into clean clothes and checked that it was still early.

Sit on the sofa and rest for a while.

It's about one o'clock in the afternoon.

Gu Chengan felt that it was almost done, so he took the key and went out.

In the carport downstairs, his electric donkey was also covered with a layer of dust.

Gu Chengan took out a towel from the armrest box and wiped the car clean.Turn the key, the instrument panel lights up, and the battery level shows 73%.

"Quite impressive."

He got into the car and turned the accelerator.

In the afternoon in Pengcheng, the sun is so hot that it can fry eggs.As he rode on the road, heat waves steamed up from the asphalt road. Fortunately, he was feeling better now.

Arriving at the door of the city bureau, Gu Chengan took out his cell phone and looked at it - one forty-seven.

After checking in at the security checkpoint, he went upstairs in a familiar way, turned two corners, and found Su Nan's office.

The door was open, and three people were sitting inside, all busy working on the computer. Su Nan was not seen.

Gu Chengan exited, took out his mobile phone and sent a message to Su Nan on WeChat:

[I arrived, but I didn’t see you!】

After a while, the other party replied:

"I'm on a mission outside. Please wait for me for a while while I sit in the office and enjoy the air conditioning."

Gu Chengan walked in again, and a young plainclothes policeman closest to the door raised his head and looked him up and down: "Who are you looking for?"

"Look for Captain Su, she asked me to wait here for a while."

When the plainclothes man heard that he was someone Captain Su knew, his attitude immediately became more enthusiastic. He stood up and dragged a chair over from the corner: "Sit down and pour the water yourself. The water dispenser is over there."

Gu Chengan thanked him, sat down and scrolled through his phone boredly.

The system is still being upgraded, the progress bar is about one-third gone, and the remaining time is about fifteen hours.
